source_review: Viewed the original q5 PNG and PDF page-1 crop together with run-07 desktop image. For proportion comparison, the source triangle base is only from left vertex A (about x=75) to right triangle vertex C (about x=224); the rightward baseline extension ending near x=282 is excluded. Source apex/base fraction is about 87/149=0.584 and cevian-foot/base fraction about 71/149=0.477. Run-07 placed the apex and foot too far right, so only neutral left vertex A was shifted right.
allowed_marks: cevian from apex to base point
uncertainties: Source pixels are schematic; marked 40° and 120° conditions remain exact in the construction. Extension beyond C is not part of the triangle-base proportion.

constructed_realization.normalization: A=(16/5,0), C=(8,0); P is placed 4 units from C on the ray at 120° to the rightward baseline. The cevian line leaves P at 260° and meets AC at F. Only neutral left vertex A is adjusted; P,C,F and the two given angle geometries are unchanged.

schematic only; no side length is printed
